metadata.method_name: SAM vs SGD calibration on Fashion-MNIST (retuned)
metadata.description: Five paired seeds, validation-only tuning at seed 101, temperature scaling fitted on validation, 12-row paired family with Holm correction.

selection.selection_criterion: final-epoch validation NLL (raw logits), lowest wins

PLACEBO SAM - SGD (shuffled test labels): ace

metadata.ace_note: Top-label, equal-count binned variant; not comparable to per-class ACE values.
